digest.component_or_area: git operation failure classification and retry
propositions: Git failure classification is duplicated across five sites with inconsistent verdicts for identical error strings, requiring consolidation into a single registry keyed by operation type and failure marker

The synthetic rc-124 timeout result is constructed in four separate locations without unified retry semantics, leaving sync._union_merge and push_recovery._merge_with_transport_retry without transient retry logic

A new git_outcome.py module must define ten GitOutcome kinds and provide classify(result, *, operation) signature that preserves operation-specific verdict divergence for 'cannot lock ref' across local, lease-push, and ref-cas contexts

Two independent guards must verify marker strings appear only in git_outcome.py (with documented escapes for _LOCK_REF_RE and lock PATH joins) and timeout construction occurs only in gitutil.run_git_bounded
The INVALID_OBJECT kind must remain distinct from FATAL to preserve index-rebuild-then-retry recovery rather than terminal failure for missing object DB entries
Existing retry predicates and marker tables migrate unchanged into the consolidated registry, with all pinning test suites unedited as proof of behavioral equivalence
